desc:
🎤 GUESS THE ANIME VOICE! 🎤
Listen to the voice… and find the right anime character before your rival! 👂

⚔️ 1v1 duels vs players or AI – 10 rounds, 4 choices!
🧠 Win to gain IQ, lose and it drops! Can you reach the rainbow tier? 🌈
😈 Troll your rival: Distort, Shuffle, Blind, Freeze or Reveal!
🪑 Open chests and collect chairs, from Common to Legendary!
🎁 Free spins, Daily and Playtime rewards!
🏆 Top Wins, Best Streak & Top Playtime leaderboards!

🔥 Naruto, Gojo and many more… can you recognize them ALL?

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite for new characters and updates!
🙏 Thanks for playing!
